hero.headline: Where to Stay in Addis Ababa
hero.subheadline: Explore Addis Ababa's neighbourhoods and find the right area for your stay. We provide personalised recommendations — not hotel inventory.

areas.name: Bole
areas.description: Addis Ababa's modern hub with international hotels, restaurants, and proximity to Bole International Airport.

areas.name: Kazanchis
areas.description: Central business district with a mix of business hotels and local restaurants, close to the UN campus.

areas.name: Piassa
areas.description: The old Italian quarter with colonial-era architecture, local cafés, and walking distance to Holy Trinity Cathedral.

areas.name: Meskel Square
areas.description: The heart of Addis Ababa, surrounded by cultural landmarks, the African Union, and major hotels.

areas.name: Old Airport
areas.description: A quieter residential area with boutique hotels and local restaurants, popular with long-term visitors.

areas.name: Sheraton Area
areas.description: Premium area near the Sheraton Addis, with upscale dining and embassy district proximity.

stayTypes.title: Short Stay
stayTypes.description: 1–3 nights for transit or quick visits. We recommend areas close to the airport or city centre.

stayTypes.title: Business Travel
stayTypes.description: Central locations near business districts with reliable WiFi and transport access.

stayTypes.title: Family Stay
stayTypes.description: Spacious accommodation in safe neighbourhoods with family-friendly dining options.

stayTypes.title: Longer Stays
stayTypes.description: Monthly or extended stays with self-catering options and local community access.

howWeHelp.headline: How We Help You Find the Right Stay
howWeHelp.description: We don't sell hotel rooms. We provide personalised accommodation recommendations based on your travel plans, preferences, and budget.

steps.title: Tell Us Your Plans
steps.description: Share your travel dates, group size, and what you'd like to do in Addis Ababa.

steps.title: We Recommend Areas
steps.description: Based on your plans, we suggest the best neighbourhoods and accommodation types.

steps.title: Book Directly
steps.description: We connect you with recommended hotels and guesthouses for direct booking.

form.headline: Request Accommodation Recommendations
form.subheadline: Tell us about your stay and we'll provide personalised suggestions within 24 hours.
form.disclosure: Accommodation options and availability are confirmed after you send your request.

faqs.question: Do you charge a booking fee?
faqs.answer: No. Our accommodation recommendations are a free service for travellers booking tours or services with us.

faqs.question: Can you book hotels directly?
faqs.answer: We provide recommendations and connect you with hotels for direct booking. We don't hold inventory or process payments for accommodation.

faqs.question: What if I need to change my booking?
faqs.answer: Since you book directly with the hotel, any changes should be made through them. We can help communicate if needed.

faqs.question: Do you offer airport pickup with accommodation?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can arrange airport transfers as part of your overall travel package. Add this to your enquiry.
